_comment: Single source of truth for the concept-tier page contract (epic 704).
Consumed by BOTH runtimes: autodoc_graph.records / autodoc_graph.render_pages
(Python, via importlib.resources) and inventory/golden-gate.js (Node, via a
repo-relative path). Editing this file is a taxonomy change, not a call-site
convenience — keep it in lockstep with references/taxonomy.md.
folder: the autodoc subdirectory a type's pages live in.
required: type-specific frontmatter fields that must be PRESENT and non-empty
on every page of that type (universal fields — type/title/created/updated/
source_repo/source_paths/status — are stamped or defaulted by the renderer
and asserted separately). 'endpoint' additionally requires route OR routes
(route-family rule), special-cased in code because it is a disjunction.
structural_fields: frontmatter fields the golden gate compares for EXACT
equality against the baseline (prose fields may differ).
